declared_in: reports/decision.md, section "Round 4: one general forecast, tested on six rivers it has never seen (declared Nov 15, 2026, before any holdout county was loaded, trained on or scored)"
git_dirty_source_means: a file under src/ or a Python file in app/ differed from git_commit
what: A general 6-month forecast (trained on the 436 development counties, 47 inputs) scored once on counties along six rivers that were never used. Cost = 3 x missed + false alarms; lower is better, so a difference below zero favours the model. Version 1 stays the reported Rio Grande system.

model.forest: version 1 settings (80 trees, depth 10, min leaf 20, sqrt inputs, seed 0)
model.trained_on: all 436 development counties, forward chaining 2008 to 2025

primary.name: 6-month cost: general model minus 'D1 or worse now'
primary.rows_used: all holdout counties: monthly issue rows, test years, full 52-week future known
primary.year_unit: the calendar year of the issue date (the date the forecast was made), all counties together
